about_the_game:
"YOUR FATHER" Is a darkly comedic, asymmetrical PvP horror game where a drunken father becomes the monster of the house — and the rest of the family must outwit him before chaos takes over.

One player becomes Dad: unpredictable, aggressive, and constantly thirsty. The others play as his family, working together to craft dangerous cocktails by mixing alcohol with sleeping pills hidden throughout the house.

Lure him in. Let him drink. Make him sleep.
But beware — while he's awake, Dad is a terrifying force of rage and power. And even if you knock him out… you’ll still have to carry his heavy, snoring body to bed.

  • 🍺 Unpredictable Father
    Dad is loud, violent, and dangerously unpredictable. Every match plays out differently depending on his mood — and your luck.

  • 🛏️ Knock Him Out, Tuck Him In
    Making him drink is only the first step. Once he's out cold, you’ll have a limited time to drag him to bed… without waking him up again.

  • 🏠 Realistic Domestic Horror
    Explore a detailed home filled with hiding spots, throwable furniture, locked cabinets, and unexpected dangers.

  • 😱 Comedy Meets Chaos
    A grotesque blend of horror and absurd family drama — perfect for co-op lovers, streamers, and chaos-driven players.
